test_title: PYST 5: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern followed is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b1a8ecf719c8bfd7fe43e3d34ca66391dbbae514873fbdc11f8365890199b33.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e07676989225cfdcdd7f4a909a04733cb320e9031a9c3601c18623533675c3a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26156a01a1d843b69421bdb2c61dd9681e876c2852f9ecd59a4b56b9a0859ab5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db39bf9c9a107f3a0c5a9f4c9ece62fb9889e4ea8194adda3f457c1f0ca28201.png] 

All follow the same pattern, except 'NQTWA’.

Hence, “**NQTWA**” is the odd one.
